Surely you have heard about the 6 months visa UAE in Dubai, and it is understandable since it can be crucial for you as an explorer or seeker of new opportunities in the united Arab emirates. Country that has a great infrastructure, and culture among other pleasures for leisure that we can enjoy if we have the six months UAE visa.

In this article, we will travel through the documents, and the process to obtain them, to provide you with a more optimal vision at the time of requesting yours, or just help you find all the necessary information for your knowledge on this subject, let us see what awaits us of this visa.

6 months visit visa in UAE for visitors

The 6 months UAE visa in Dubai, is a visa that will allow you to stay in the country for a period of up to 6 months, for tourism purposes, to visit a family member, or to do business. This visa will give you a short stay to enjoy the experiences given by the country.

Keep in mind that with this six months visa UAE you will have the flexibility to travel throughout the country, see its culture firsthand, and explore tourist areas. In other words, you will be able to live the UAE lifestyle for an extended period. In addition, this visa has a longer period compared to other short-term visas.

Eligibility

To be eligible to obtain the six months visa UAE in Dubai, you must take into account specific requirements set by the immigration authorities. But generally, these are the eligibility criteria that will be taken into account:

  1. Purpose of travel:
  • You must show a legitimate purpose for your trip such as tourism, family visit, or business.
  1. Valid passport:
  • In addition to having your passport valid for at least 6 months from your date of entry to the UAE.
  1. Compliance with the law:
  • you must not have any criminal record and comply with all UAE regulations and laws.
  1. Age:
  • There is no specific age for you to be eligible for the 6 months visa UAE, but keep in mind that, if you are under 18, you will need to be accompanied by your parents or a legal guardian.
  1. Financial requirements:
  • You have to maintain a balance in your bank account of 4,000 USD or the equivalent of that in other countries’ currencies for the last 6 months.
  • This is so that you can guarantee your financial security during your stay in the country.
  1. Medical insurance:
  • In addition, you must have valid medical insurance that is applicable for the 6 months visa UAE.
  1. Travel Itinerary:
  • Finally, you must have an arrival and departure ticket for the eau deportation.
  • In addition, you must provide proof of your stay in a hotel or residence in the UAE.

Some of these criteria could change depending on your nationality or any other case, you should keep in mind to check your eligibility criteria directly with the UAE embassy or on its official website.

Application process

The application process to obtain your 6 months visa UAE can vary as you can do it by different methods, some of which will make it easier for you to obtain it, let us review what these methods are and how we can do it:

Personally:

  • Registration/ UAE pass:
    • You must register for the UAE Pass. It is a process that you will have to do to access the UAE government’s online services.
  • Application and payment of all fees:
    • After you are registered, you must apply for your 6 months visa UAE. Remember to pay the fees corresponding to your visa.
  • Obtaining the 6 months visa UAE:
    • After all the steps you must wait to receive your entry permit which you can use to enter the UAE as a tourist.

With airlines:

  • Some airlines may provide you with their services if you travel with them. You could consult Etihad Airways, Emirates, Fly Dubai, and Air Arabia, to know more about their services and facilities in obtaining your 6 months visa UAE.

Travel agencies and hotels:

  • Some travel agencies may offer to help you obtain your 6 months UAE visa if you purchase your ticket through them and stay at a specific hotel.
  • You can also consult travel agencies in your local country to find out about different tourist plans to help you obtain your 6 months visa UAE.

Documents Required

To apply for a 6 months visa in the UAE you must have the following documents:

  • Valid passport: Your passport must be valid for 6 months from the date of entry into the UAE.
  • Visa application form: You must also have a completed and signed visa application form.
  • New photos of yourself: They must also be recently taken photos.
  • Financial bank balance: You must have a bank statement of 4000 USD or its equivalent in foreign currencies during the 6 months; this can be categorized under the visa cost in UAE.
  • Tourist program: You must provide your entire itinerary or tourist schedule.
  • Tickets: You must also have your arrival and departure tickets.

Visa renewal

You should know that, if you can renew your tourist visa, this can be done directly from the UAE consulate. Let us see what series of steps we must follow to do this

  1. Verify your eligibility:
  • First of all, you must make sure that you are eligible for UAE visa renewal. It is important that you still meet all the terms of eligibility for your eligibility to be positive.
  1. Have all your documents:
  • In addition, you should prepare your valid passport, visa renewal application form, new photos, proof of your financial means, and other documents that may be required.
  1. Visit the Office of Residency and Alien Affairs:
  • You must go to the office of the General Directorate of Residence and Foreigners Affairs GDRFA at least 48 hours before your visa expires. You must also submit your passport and all required documents at the time of visa renewal.
  1. Payment of fees:
  • After that, you will need to pay the 6 months visa UAE Price plus all fees for your visa. These may vary depending on the duration of the renewal.
  1. Visa Approval and Renewal:
  • Finally, if your visa is approved, it will be renewed immediately.

Normal travelers – six-month visit visa in UAE

Normal travelers seeking a six-month visa are also eligible for the visa, they just need to follow the same steps mentioned above and comply with all the regulations, let us see what they are.

  • Verify eligibility
  • Gather documents
  • Valid passport with 6 months of validity
  • Recent passport-size photos
  • Proof of funds of $4,000 for 6 months
  • Proof of accommodation
  • Travel Insurance
  • Travel schedule, including flight reservations
  • Submit visa application
  • Pay all visa fees and the 6 months visa UAE price
  • Wait for visa evaluation
  • Receive visa and travel to the UAE

Thirty days on arrival nationals

Inhabitants of some countries can obtain a tourist visa on arrival in the UAE, valid for 30 days. This visa will allow you to stay in the country for tourism or business purposes without the need to complete all the formalities in advance.

Also, please note that this visa can be extended for an additional 10 days. The price of the visa may vary according to several factors but it can cost from 250 AED to 300 AED.

FAQs

How Much Does a 6 Month Visit Visa for Dubai Cost?

As of August 2025, the cost currently ranges between AED 1,000 and AED 1,500. Prices can vary among service providers and can be affected by other factors as well.

What Is the 6 Month Visa Rule in UAE?

The 6 month UAE visit visa allows multiple entries, but holders must exit or extend their stay before expiry to avoid penalties. It cannot be converted directly into residency.

What Documents Are Needed to Apply for A 6-Month UAE Visit Visa?

You will need:

  • a valid passport with 6 months minimum validity
  • passport-sized photographs
  • proof of funds
  • confirmed return ticket
  • in some cases, you also need UAE-based sponsorship documents

What Is the Processing Time for A UAE 6-Month Visit Visa Under Standard Service?

 Standard processing usually takes 2 to 5 working days.

Can the Visit Visa Be Extended Beyond 6 Months without Exiting the UAE, and What Are the Conditions?

Yes, extensions are possible depending on current regulations. Approval depends on immigration policies at the time of your request.

Are There Financial or Investment Requirements (E.g., Minimum Bank Deposit) Associated with This UAE Visit Visa?

Generally, no investment is required. But applicants must show proof of financial stability, such as bank statements or sponsor guarantees, to ensure they can support their stay.
